text:
marco: deploy-bot scheduled rollout v3.4.1 -> eu-west1 10% starting now. change-window 14:00-16:00 UTC. release notes: https://redwood/release/3.4.1 :rocket:

deploy-bot: [notice] traffic shift initiated: 10% -> eu-west1 (v3.4.1). monitoring hooks: latency, 5xx, kv-cache.

ella: quick Q — did we pin dedicated customers on v3.4.0? some reserved pools shouldn't get v3.4.1

samir: yes, dedicated pools pinned to v3.4.0. public routing only for staged rollout.

nora: watching metrics. seeing small p95 bump in eu-west1 (p95 +90ms) and a couple of 502s from worker-3. not huge but trending. putting thresholds: rollback if 5xx > 0.5% OR p95 > 300ms sustained 3min

marco: can we throttle back to 1% and pause while we triage? prefer pin to previous version for now.

deploy-bot: traffic adjusted -> 1% for eu-west1. previous config saved as rollout/2026-03-20-1778301123

ops-oncall: tail logs show repeated kv-cache eviction spikes on worker-3:
```
[2026-03-20T14:13:22Z] worker-3 OOM when allocating 256MB for kv-cache shard
[2026-03-20T14:13:23Z] evicted 128MB, latency +120ms
```

samir: deferring ramp. recommend pinning region to v3.4.0 until fix. I'll open a quick PR to revert recent cache config change.

nora: agreed. marco can you authorize pin/rollback? I'm happy to execute.

marco: go ahead. run pin command and annotate release notes.

nora: running: `rbctl pin-version --region eu-west1 --service model-serving --version v3.4.0 --by nora --reason "kv-cache regressions in canary"`

deploy-bot: [action] region eu-west1 pinned to v3.4.0 by nora. rollback threshold triggered: manual pin. audit: /ops/audit/1778301123

ella: adding note to release: "paused rollout for eu-west1 due to kv-cache pressure; investigating." @samir please link PR when ready.

samir: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/482 — revert cache shard tuning. testing locally.

marco: thanks. schedule a re-rollout only after QA signoff and green metrics for 30m. moving to postmortem if needed. :white_check_mark:

nora: I'll keep monitoring and post an update in 20m. tagging @ops-oncall for followup.

ops-oncall: on it. will run heap dump on worker-3 if we see OOM again. :mag:

marco: consensus: paused, pinned, awaiting PR + 30m green. closing this thread when we start ramp again.

nora: ack, will update.
